control_flow: followInTheDark: if dark (light below 70 %), follow the line by its brightness (below 90 % curve left, above 90 % curve right, exactly 90 % go to avoidWalls); if bright, go to avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if dark, turn away from an obstacle on the left or right (else go to driveInTheDark); if bright, go to driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if dark, drive forward at 30 %; if bright, go to stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is in front, stop; else go to followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

uncertainties: You said it should drive straight where there is no line in the dark, but the plain floor reads about 83 %, below 90 %, so the program curves left instead of driving straight.
The line tracker can't tell a black line (0 %) from the plain peach floor (83 %): both are below 90 %, so on a floor without a line the dark part still steers left.
The wall-avoidance and drive-straight parts only run in the dark at a floor reading of exactly 90 %, which practically never happens.
'In the light, follow the line as before' doesn't say what 'before' was: the program, in the light, stops at a front obstacle and otherwise follows the line.
